# Rubric Grader

## Summary
Criteria as rows, levels as buttons, live total and letter, late deduction with waive, feedback, override; writes through Grade Submission and shows refusals verbatim.

## Usage
`<RubricGrader @submission={{s}} @context={{@context}} @gradedBy={{me}} />`

## Non-goals
Does not grade without a rubric.
attributes.cardDescription: Grades a submission against its rubric: levels as buttons, live total and letter, late deduction, feedback and override.
